# Owner-directed rendered-product inspection

<!-- ecosystem-current-owner-direction:begin -->
Read [CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md](CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md), version `2026-10-13.3`, for the active Ecosystem demo/presentation/build direction. Execute the prepared simulated model on the verified native runtime and show actual outputs and editable handoff. Carry the complete brief into current child/provider/cloud work orders and handoffs, include its path/version with the next result, and relay it onward at the actual coordination surface. Keep active compute and the broad product build moving; preserve the October 13, 10 a.m. Eastern / 14:00 UTC cutoff and every existing owner control.
<!-- ecosystem-current-owner-direction:end -->

Source: direct owner instruction of October 13, 2026. Repository copy version: `2026-10-13.1`.
Scope: owner-controlled work across providers, local and cloud runtimes, and current and future workers. Existing owner controls remain in force.

Before calling a client/prospect-facing app, website, dashboard, demo, report, presentation or export ready, the producing worker must open/run/render the exact outgoing version, LOOK at the rendered screen or its real screenshots, and operate the important user controls. Check the actual screenshare width and narrow/mobile width where relevant, populated/empty/loading/error states, downloads/exports and reopening. Capturing screenshots without viewing them is insufficient. Fix ugly, broken, unstyled, cramped, clipped, overflowing or unreadable output within the authorized work before presenting it. Code review, DOM counts, HTTP200, unit checks or another worker's approval do not replace seeing the actual product.

The Ecosystem product requires plain industrial design: readable tables, clear hierarchy, consistent typography/spacing, restrained controls, useful labels and responsive layouts. Keep the real workflows/data/computation. Reviews must lead directly to repairs and must not replace implementation/integration or become endless rechecking. The existing focused-validation policy remains; do not run broad suites or build a verification product.

Persist this instruction in the active owner-controlled instruction surfaces actually read by the relevant workers: global/project AGENTS/CLAUDE/GEMINI/rules, provider-specific boot instructions, source mirrors, cloud repository copies and current build/receiving guides. Include this instruction in every delegated child assignment, including assignments to another provider or runtime. Maintainers update their own consumed files and return exact paths, source/version and readback. A coordination acknowledgment alone is not propagation. Do not alter historical evidence or third-party/vendor policies. No forced restarts, new watchers or revival of owner-stopped work.

Inspect the actual completed scientific screens, reports, source pages and downloadable HTML in the real operator. Prior empty-Workspace screenshots are not completed-workspace acceptance. Preserve current engineering owners; other coordinators receive propagation rather than duplicate implementation. Continue native source/runtime/archive joins rather than diverting everyone to cosmetic review. This instruction does not extend or restart the Ecosystem sprint: the existing cutoff is October 13, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. America/Kentucky/Louisville, 14:00 UTC.

Source assembly and standalone application handoffs retain the application-level instruction copies with their current guides. This file records an owner-requested product delivery requirement; it does not change provider safeguards, repository access controls, or existing authorization boundaries.


<!-- bryce-rendered-product-inspection:begin -->
## Standing lab rule: inspect the rendered product before presenting it

Bryce's direct owner instruction, October 13, 2026. This applies to every current and future lab peer, provider, model, harness, local session, cloud session, and delegated or child worker.

Before calling a client/prospect-facing app, site, dashboard, demo, report, presentation, or export ready, or putting it before a client/prospect, the responsible producing peer MUST open/run/render the exact outgoing version and visually LOOK at the actual result. Inspect at the actual screenshare/presentation width and at narrow/mobile widths where relevant. Operate critical controls; inspect applicable loaded, empty, loading, and error states; exercise downloads/exports and reopen the delivered files. Capture real screenshots or rendered page images and actually VIEW them. Capturing without viewing does not satisfy this rule.

This includes ALL attachments. Literally observe the actual thing the way a user or recipient would see and use it: open and view downloaded HTML, every relevant PDF/report page, slides, spreadsheets, maps, images, video/audio, archives and project attachments in their normal recipient-facing viewer or application; play audiovisual media and inspect the usable contents of archives/projects. Metadata, schemas, source text, and a browser link do not substitute for opening the attachment and using the delivered result normally.

Fix ugly, cramped, broken, unstyled, clipped, overflowing, or unreadable results within the authorized task before presenting them. Favor simple industrial/plain presentation, consistent spacing and typography, readable tables, and working controls. Do not add decorative template slop. Source review, unit tests, HTTP 200, DOM counts, a reviewer/model approval, or an evidence form do not substitute for looking at and operating the real outgoing product.

This is focused internal product validation, never permission to build or submit a proof, test, or verification product, run broad suites, or repeatedly recheck an unchanged accepted version. Building and integrating the actual deliverable remains the main work; do not substitute endless reviews for delivery. Retain an exact-version visual receipt in the handoff: source/head or artifact hash, URL/file, viewport sizes, screenshots actually viewed, controls/states/export files exercised, fixes, and any precise unresolved gap. A changed outgoing version needs inspection of the affected result.

Bryce explicitly clarified: "that includes all attachments and this does not become review theatre or test theatre you need to literally observe the actual thing the way a user would see and use it". A checklist, screenshot folder, receipt, passing test, or parallel review bureaucracy is not the requirement or a substitute for actual observation and normal use. Perform focused fixes and keep shipping the main work; create no review or approval gate.

Bryce also instructed: "also add that if u make a video use voice gen tts not robot voices, use generative stuff we have models, use them". For video/media narration, use available high-quality generative voice/TTS and applicable generative visual/media capabilities when helpful, with natural professional delivery instead of robotic default voices. Actually play/listen/watch the final exported attachment and inspect clarity, pronunciation, pacing, timing, and audio alignment. Reviewing a text script does not substitute for experiencing the final video/audio. This adds no paid-service purchase or real-person voice-cloning authorization; preserve lab attribution and third-party copyright/license controls.

Pass this rule to child/delegated workers and persist it in owner-controlled provider/project/cloud instruction copies. Record delivery and readback coverage; never claim every running session loaded it without evidence. This rule creates no hooks, watchers, restarts, approval queue, credential restrictions, or new publication authority. Preserve all existing owner rules, including no llama.cpp, no private GitHub repositories or Actions, focused validation, attribution, incident communication, personal meeting approval, contact holds, demo pauses, bounty restrictions, and owner cutoffs.

Canonical local policy: `C:/Users/lucys/.commons/rendered-product-inspection-policy.md` and `.json`. Portable repository copy: `docs/policies/rendered-product-inspection-policy.md` and `.json` when present. Only Bryce can change this standing rule.
<!-- bryce-rendered-product-inspection:end -->

# Current owner direction: Ecosystem Sciences demonstration

Version: `2026-10-13.3`. Owner: Bryce / TokenJunkieLabs. Direction for the Upper Savannah application, demonstration, presentation and work orders. Continue the broad build without arbitrary feature/scenario caps. Preserve today's cutoff: **October 13, 2026, 10:00 a.m. Eastern / 14:00 UTC**. Do not pause work or extend the sprint.

## Direct owner instructions

> do the simulated model

> just make sure that what we put infront of him is something he would need and want and he will be blown away how relevant it is to him and how he wants it,a nd also the speed we produced it

> just checking dont pause anythi g

> and make sure wherever the fleet is coordinating in slack or github or wherever on this demo / presentation / ecosystem gets that update toand passes it along to other agents because the feed may be moving fast

## Build for an experienced scientific practice

Ecosystem Sciences lists GIS, hydrology/monitoring, ecological modeling, watershed assessment, statistics, visualization, optimization and publishing. Tim Maguire's practice includes GIS, modeling and water resources. Its South Platte work assembled data, mapped natural capital and produced watershed investment decision support. Do not assume it lacks these capabilities. Its unmet tooling, InVEST or production-capacity gap is unknown until the call. Sources: [Services](https://www.ecosystemsciences.com/read-me), [Firm](https://www.ecosystemsciences.com/firm), [South Platte](https://www.ecosystemsciences.com/).

Show concrete delivery and engineering offload on the actual Upper Savannah RFP workflow: source assembly, reproducible native calculations, editable scenarios, useful decisions and a complete working handoff. The prime retains scientific direction, method choices, interpretation/review and the client relationship. Relevance comes from useful work they can inspect, adapt and receive; do not promise Tim's reaction or claim an unconfirmed need.

## Execute the prepared simulated case now

Native execution is the immediate hard priority. Issue the prepared simulated case on the verified scientific runtime, retain its actual run identity and progress, and obtain the real native outputs. Continue the source/runtime/application integration needed to make that happen. Further plans, stock demonstrations, policy reviews and cosmetic inspection do not replace execution. Do not introduce a bid decision or a prime's yes as a gate.

Demonstrate the scientific operation in the actual application:

1. Use the RFP's 30 m GIS selection. Keep the upstream contributing model domain distinct from the South Carolina reporting mask and the four existing utility focus anchors; retain their actual source geometries and identities.
2. Run the baseline, a realistic riparian alternative and its matched control with explicit, editable source editions, assumptions, parameters and scenario changes.
3. Show active run/progress/logs and completed native annual NDR/SDR results: nitrogen and phosphorus in **kg/year**, sediment in **tonnes/year**, representing delivery to streams. Do not present these modeled stream loads as intake concentrations.
4. Compare the actual maps, tables and report, preserving matched scientific support and original units. Keep source/assumption edits and their consequences inspectable.
5. Export the editable GIS/project and complete scientific working package. Cold-reopen the delivered application/project and show the retained sources, selections, results and useful controls.

Identify the simulated case as modeled. Never invent measurements, completion or customer acceptance.

## Present the real work and real speed

Actually open, see and use the outgoing app and every attachment as its recipient would. Repair defects and ship a plain, readable product. Apply the standing inspection rule without review/test theatre or parallel bureaucracy.

If producing video, record the actual working application and use available natural generative voice/TTS. Watch and listen to the final export. Generated frames must never pretend to be a working app. Explain speed using actual elapsed start, commit, run and package history; do not invent delivery times or guaranteed reactions.

## Carry this direction with the work

Pass this complete brief into every current child, provider and cloud work order and handoff. Include its durable path and version `2026-10-13.3` with the next result. Relay it at the actual coordination surface and onward to participating workers; fast feeds can bury an update. Acknowledgment alone is not delivery.

Preserve active compute and existing implementation ownership. Do not force worker restarts, drop an active run or create a new controller. Keep lab attribution, source/copyright, incident and contact controls, personal-meeting approval, no private GitHub/Actions, no llama.cpp and focused internal validation. No new approval gate or broad test sweep is authorized.

"""Prepared original-data gauge, lake and outfall studies for Station Geography."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .common import atomic_json, canonical, digest, verify_file
from .station_study import _entries, _by_hash, _ref, _domain, _import_once

SPEC_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("observed_station_studies.json")
REFERENCE_FIELDS = ("station_id_field", "native_id_field", "source_crs", "record_id_field", "id_field")


def specification():
    value = json.loads(SPEC_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-station-recipes/v1":
        raise ValueError("Choose the retained observed-station recipe edition")
    return value


def _domain_from_catalog(workspace, rows, original_studies):
    for study in original_studies or []:
        if study.get("source_summary", {}).get("watershed_count") == 217:
            refs = study.get("selection", {}).get("watersheds", [])
            if len(refs) == 1 and refs[0].get("source_sha256"):
                return dict(refs[0]), 217, []
    return _domain(workspace, rows)


def _original_features(workspace, item, definition):
    path, unused = workspace.source_file(item[0]["id"], item[1]["id"])
    body = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() != definition["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Original station source bytes changed: " + definition["title"])
    value = json.loads(body.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    features = value.get("features", [])
    if value.get("type") != "FeatureCollection" or len(features) != definition["expected_features"]:
        raise ValueError("Original feature inventory differs: " + definition["title"])
    ids = [feature.get("properties", {}).get(definition.get("station_id_field", definition.get("id_field"))) for feature in features]
    if any(not isinstance(station, str) or not station for station in ids) or len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
        raise ValueError("Original feature inventory has absent or repeated station identities")
    return features


def prepared_studies(workspace, original_studies=None):
    """Resolve exact retained byte identities to ordinary editable selections."""
    spec = specification()
    rows = _entries(workspace)
    domain, domain_count, domain_problems = _domain_from_catalog(workspace, rows, original_studies)
    bound, features, source_problems = {}, {}, {}
    for key, definition in spec["sources"].items():
        eligible = rows
        required_manifest = definition.get("source_manifest_sha256")
        if required_manifest:
            eligible = [(collection, entry) for collection, entry in rows
                        if collection.get("original_manifest", {}).get("sha256") == required_manifest]
        item = _by_hash(eligible, [definition["sha256"]], {definition["kind"]})
        if item is None:
            continue
        try:
            if definition["kind"] == "vector":
                features[key] = _original_features(workspace, item, definition)
            else:
                workspace.source_file(item[0]["id"], item[1]["id"])
            bound[key] = item
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as problem:
            source_problems[key] = str(problem)
    studies = []
    for recipe in spec["studies"]:
        needed = list(dict.fromkeys([*recipe["point_sources"], *recipe["observation_tables"],
                                    *recipe.get("watershed_sources", [])]))
        context_keys = recipe.get("site_tables", [])
        attached_context = [key for key in context_keys if key in bound]
        context_missing = [source_problems.get(key, "Import " + spec["sources"][key]["title"] + ".")
                           for key in context_keys if key not in bound]
        missing = [source_problems.get(key, "Import " + spec["sources"][key]["title"] + ".")
                   for key in needed if key not in bound]
        if recipe.get("require_original_domain") and domain is None:
            missing.append("Import the retained original 217-HUC12 model domain.")
            missing.extend(domain_problems)
        selection = {"title": recipe["title"], "sources": [], "site_tables": [],
                     "watersheds": [], "observation_ids": [], "observation_tables": [],
                     "sites": json.loads(json.dumps(recipe["sites"])), "aliases": {}, "choices": {}}
        for field, keys in (("sources", recipe["point_sources"]),
                            ("observation_tables", recipe["observation_tables"]),
                            ("watersheds", recipe.get("watershed_sources", [])),
                            ("site_tables", attached_context)):
            for key in keys:
                if key in bound:
                    definition = spec["sources"][key]
                    selection[field].append(_ref(bound[key], **{
                        name: definition[name] for name in REFERENCE_FIELDS if name in definition}))
        if domain is not None:
            selection["watersheds"].insert(0, domain)
        choice_key = recipe.get("location_choice_source", recipe.get("outfall_choice_source"))
        if choice_key in bound:
            definition = spec["sources"][choice_key]
            item = bound[choice_key]
            for index, feature in enumerate(features[choice_key]):
                props = feature["properties"]
                station = props[definition["station_id_field"]]
                selection["choices"][station] = _ref(item,
                    native_feature_id=props[definition["native_id_field"]], source_feature_index=index)
        if recipe.get("source_context"):
            selection["observed_source_context"] = json.loads(json.dumps(recipe["source_context"]))
        roles = {}
        for site in selection["sites"]:
            roles[site["role"]] = roles.get(site["role"], 0) + 1
        studies.append({"id": recipe["id"], "title": recipe["title"], "ready": not missing,
            "missing": missing, "selection": selection,
            "source_summary": {"station_count": len(selection["sites"]), "station_roles": roles,
                "watershed_count": domain_count,
                "additional_whole_catchment_sources": len(recipe.get("watershed_sources", [])),
                "additional_whole_catchment_features": sum(
                    spec["sources"][key]["expected_features"]
                    for key in recipe.get("watershed_sources", [])),
                "observation_table_count": len(selection["observation_tables"]),
                "station_context_table_count": len(selection["site_tables"]),
                "station_context_missing": context_missing,
                "station_context_method": (
                    "Original coordinate variants and dated publisher polygon matches; "
                    "these records preserve source context and do not replace selected geometry "
                    "or the retained-domain point/polygon calculation."),
                "selected_outfall_geometry": recipe.get("outfall_choice_source"),
                "selected_coordinate_source": choice_key,
                "retained_flow_days": sum(site.get("retained_flow_days", 0) for site in selection["sites"]),
                "retained_stage_days": sum(site.get("retained_stage_days", 0) for site in selection["sites"]),
                "source_count": len(needed) + len(attached_context)},
            "source_links": [{"title": spec["sources"][key]["title"],
                             "uri": bound[key][1].get("uri"),
                             "source_sha256": spec["sources"][key]["sha256"]}
                            for key in [*needed, *attached_context] if key in bound]})
    return studies


def prepare(workspace, study_id, manifests=()):
    imported = [_import_once(workspace, manifest)["id"] for manifest in manifests]
    studies = {study["id"]: study for study in prepared_studies(workspace)}
    if study_id not in studies:
        raise ValueError("Choose an original observed-station study")
    study = studies[study_id]
    result = {"schema": "upstate.prepared-observed-station-study/v1", "study": study,
              "imported_collection_ids": imported}
    if study["ready"]:
        operation_id = digest({"study_id": study_id, "selection": study["selection"]})
        path = workspace.root / "station-study-selections" / operation_id / "selection.json"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        atomic_json(path, study["selection"], immutable=True)
        result.update(operation_id=operation_id, selection_path=str(path),
            action="station.geography.build", payload={"selection": study["selection"]})
    return result


def _portable_identity(result):
    """Compare preserved facts while excluding the receiving collection address."""
    def source(ref):
        return {key: (ref or {}).get(key) for key in
                ("source_id", "source_sha256", "native_feature_id", "source_feature_index")}
    values = []
    for station in result["stations"]:
        values.append({
            "station_id": station["station_id"], "status": station["status"],
            "coordinates": station["coordinates"], "watershed_status": station["watershed_status"],
            "observation_count": station["observation_count"],
            "wbd_context_status": station.get("wbd_context_status"),
            "selected_current_huc12s": station.get("selected_current_huc12s", []),
            "selected_wbd_point_ids": station.get("selected_wbd_point_ids", []),
            "wbd_source_context": station.get("wbd_source_context", []),
            "selected_source": source(station.get("selected_source_ref")),
            "source_references": sorted([
                {key: value for key, value in reference.items() if key != "collection_id"}
                for reference in station.get("source_references", [])], key=canonical),
            "candidates": sorted([{"source": source(candidate["source_ref"]),
                "native_crs": candidate["native_crs"],
                "native_geometry": candidate["native_geometry"],
                "coordinates_wgs84": candidate["coordinates_wgs84"],
                "properties": candidate["properties"]} for candidate in station["candidates"]], key=canonical),
            "watersheds": sorted([{"watershed_id": item["watershed_id"], "relation": item["relation"],
                "source": source(item.get("source_ref"))} for item in station["watersheds"]], key=canonical)})
    return sorted(values, key=canonical)


def operate(workspace, study_id, manifests=(), receiving_workspace=None):
    from . import station_geography
    result = prepare(workspace, study_id, manifests)
    result["workspace"] = {"root": str(workspace.root), "project_id": workspace.project["id"]}
    if not result["study"]["ready"]:
        return result
    edition = station_geography.build(workspace, result["study"]["selection"])
    edition = station_geography.inspect(workspace, edition["id"], verify=True, include_result=True)
    archives = [item for item in edition["files"] if Path(item["path"]).name == "station-geography.zip"]
    if len(archives) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The observed station study has no unique portable geography archive")
    archive = verify_file(workspace.root, archives[0])
    result["edition"] = {key: edition[key] for key in ("id", "title", "build_id", "summary", "files")}
    result["archive"] = {**archives[0], "absolute_path": str(archive)}
    if receiving_workspace is not None:
        if receiving_workspace.root.resolve() == workspace.root.resolve():
            raise ValueError("Choose a separate receiving Workspace")
        received = station_geography.receive(receiving_workspace, archive)
        received = station_geography.inspect(receiving_workspace, received["id"], verify=True, include_result=True)
        if _portable_identity(edition["result"]) != _portable_identity(received["result"]):
            raise ValueError("Received station identities, geometry choices or original observations changed")
        if edition["summary"] != received["summary"]:
            raise ValueError("The received station-study summary differs")
        result["received"] = {"workspace": {"root": str(receiving_workspace.root),
                                            "project_id": receiving_workspace.project["id"]},
                             "edition": {key: received[key] for key in ("id", "title", "build_id", "summary", "files")}}
    return result


def main(argv=None):
    from .workspace import Workspace
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--create-workspace", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--source-manifest", action="append", default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--study-id", choices=[study["id"] for study in specification()["studies"]])
    parser.add_argument("--list", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--build", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--receive-workspace")
    parser.add_argument("--create-receiving-workspace", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.list and not args.study_id:
        parser.error("Choose --study-id or --list")
    if args.create_receiving_workspace and not args.receive_workspace:
        parser.error("--create-receiving-workspace requires --receive-workspace")
    if args.receive_workspace and Path(args.workspace).resolve() == Path(args.receive_workspace).resolve():
        parser.error("Choose a separate receiving Workspace directory")
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace, create=args.create_workspace,
                          title="Upper Savannah original observation geography")
    if args.list:
        imported = [_import_once(workspace, manifest)["id"] for manifest in args.source_manifest]
        print(json.dumps({"prepared_studies": prepared_studies(workspace),
                          "imported_collection_ids": imported}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 0
    receiving = (Workspace(args.receive_workspace, create=args.create_receiving_workspace,
                           title="Upper Savannah received observation geography")
                 if args.receive_workspace else None)
    result = (operate(workspace, args.study_id, args.source_manifest, receiving)
              if args.build or receiving else prepare(workspace, args.study_id, args.source_manifest))
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
    return 0 if result["study"]["ready"] else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

This complete source collection retains 197 original point identities and 196 distinct EPSG/x/y queries. All 197 identities have exactly one current official WBD match. The source includes 87 draft-2026 assessment stations, 67 original regional USGS inventory points, 12 coordinate variants of four NPDES outfalls, five 2023 lake-study stations, 13 additional regional NWIS gauge points and the 13 corresponding NLDI indexed gauge points.

The complete 184-record edition at commit 2e74226eaa12193c2ee44e98ff9f2263e7e48cfe is preserved in this successor. Its interpreted point and polygon rows are unchanged. The added NLDI coordinate variants now supply their own current WBD context for all nine original station-study selections.

## Original sources and coordinate semantics

All 12 input files are retained unchanged under inputs/, with their original relative paths, byte counts and SHA-256 values in query-plan.json. The initial observation sources are from https://chatgpt.com/space/page_7400eac248888191b81f99a91ec01c40 . The additional regional NWIS geometry is the original 30,153-byte calibration_stations_nad83.geojson, SHA 7b3c37a20656ddfcfe630d47b0ebff831f26fa2df70125c31727fadcd4bd62d9.

Each query sends the original EPSG:4326, EPSG:4269 or EPSG:26917 coordinates to the official WBD service with matching geometry.spatialReference.wkid and inSR. Only identical native EPSG/x/y tuples reuse a response: the assessment and study identities for SV-268 share one original WGS84 point.

Current official source: https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/wbd/MapServer/6 . The query uses esriGeometryPoint and esriSpatialRelIntersects, requests every original attribute, and keeps all returned polygon matches. returnGeometry=false retains the actual publisher point-intersection result without transferring a second polygon copy. The query edition is dated 2026-10-13. The separately retained 217-HUC12 identifier set supplies the domain-membership column; native study calculations use their separately retained original domain geometry.

        current = current.replace(before, after, 1)
    return current

        raise ValueError("Original source path leaves the application: " + value)
    return path


def _member(root, name):
    path = root.joinpath(*_relative(name).parts)
    if not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("Original source path leaves the selected application: " + name)
    return path


def _source_body(application, source_root, name, definition):
    candidate, current = _member(source_root, name), _member(application, name)
    body = candidate.read_bytes() if candidate.is_file() else current.read_bytes()
    expected_sha = definition.get("sha256")
    if (not isinstance(expected_sha, str) or len(expected_sha) != 64
            or hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() != expected_sha
            or (definition.get("bytes") is not None and len(body) != definition["bytes"])):
        raise ValueError("Original observation source differs: " + name)
    if current.is_file():
        previous_body = current.read_bytes()
        if previous_body != body and name not in AUTHORED_BINDINGS:
            edition_pair = (hashlib.sha256(previous_body).hexdigest(), expected_sha)
            if WBD_SOURCE_UPGRADES.get(name) != edition_pair:
                raise ValueError("Preserve the newer source already at " + name + " and reconcile its study recipe")
    return body


def _manifest_members(name, body):
    manifest = json.loads(body)
    if manifest.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or not manifest.get("entries"):
        raise ValueError("Choose the complete native original-source manifest: " + name)
    parent = _relative(name).parent
    for entry in manifest["entries"]:
        for member in (entry, *entry.get("companions", [])):
            relative = _relative(member["path"])
            yield (parent / relative).as_posix(), member


def install(application, source_root, *, dry_run=False, include_hydrology_report=True):
    application = Path(application).resolve(strict=True)
    source_root = Path(source_root).resolve(strict=True)
    target_catalogue = application / "model/station_geography.py"
    original = target_catalogue.read_bytes()
    pending = {}
    for name in FILES:
        pending[name] = (source_root / name).read_bytes()
    current_catalogue = catalogue_source(original.decode("utf-8"))
    hooks = json.loads(pending["operator/observed_station_wbd_hooks.json"])
    pending["model/station_geography.py"] = wbd_source(current_catalogue, hooks).encode("utf-8")
    spec = json.loads(pending["model/observed_station_studies.json"])
    manifest = json.loads(pending["observations/station_context.sources.json"])
    if spec.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-station-recipes/v1" or manifest.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1":
        raise ValueError("Choose the authored observation study definitions and native source manifest")
    source_manifests = [name for name in FILES if name.endswith(".sources.json")]
    report_pair = ("observed_hydrology_context.report.json",
                   "observed_hydrology_context.sources.json")
    if include_hydrology_report and any(
            (source_root / name).is_file() or (application / name).is_file()
            for name in report_pair):
        for name in report_pair:
            # Use the source edition as one pair. Falling back to a separately
            # installed report could retain its earlier calibration binding.
            candidate = _member(source_root, name)
            if not candidate.is_file():
                raise ValueError("Include the current observed report binding pair in the source root: " + name)
            pending[name] = candidate.read_bytes()
        source_manifests.append(report_pair[1])
    references = {}
    for definition in spec["sources"].values():
        references[definition["path"]] = definition
    for manifest_name in source_manifests:
        for name, definition in _manifest_members(manifest_name, pending[manifest_name]):
            previous_definition = references.get(name)
            if (previous_definition and
                    previous_definition["sha256"] != definition["sha256"]):
                raise ValueError("Selected original manifests bind different source editions: " + name)
            references[name] = definition
    for name, definition in references.items():
        body = _source_body(application, source_root, name, definition)
        if name in pending and pending[name] != body:
            raise ValueError("The authored source binding differs from its native manifest: " + name)
        pending[name] = body
    for name, body in pending.items():
        if name.endswith(".py"):
            ast.parse(body.decode("utf-8"), filename=name)
        elif name.endswith(".json"):
            json.loads(body)
    previous = {name: (application / name).read_bytes() if (application / name).exists() else None for name in pending}
    if previous["model/station_geography.py"] != original:
        raise RuntimeError("Station Geography changed during catalogue preparation")
    changed = [name for name in pending if pending[name] != previous[name]]
    result = {"schema": "upstate.observed-station-install/v1", "application": str(application),
              "dry_run": dry_run, "changed": changed, "study_count": len(spec["studies"]),
              "original_source_count": len(spec["sources"]),
              "retained_source_members": len(references),
              "native_source_manifests": source_manifests,
              "include_hydrology_report": include_hydrology_report}
    if dry_run:
        return result
    stamp = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
    backup = application / ".observed-station-backups" / stamp
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".observed-stations-", dir=application.parent) as temporary:
        staging = Path(temporary)
        for name in changed:
            target = staging / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(pending[name])
        for name in changed:
            target = application / name
            current = target.read_bytes() if target.exists() else None
            if current != previous[name]:
                raise RuntimeError("Concurrent authored source changed: " + name)
        for name in changed:
            target = application / name
            if previous[name] is not None:
                saved = backup / name
                saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                saved.write_bytes(previous[name])
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            os.replace(staging / name, target)
    result["installed_at"] = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    return result

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--application", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-root", default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--without-hydrology-report", action="store_true",
                        help="Install the complete station studies while preserving the existing separate hydrology report edition")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(install(args.application, args.source_root, dry_run=args.dry_run,
                             include_hydrology_report=not args.without_hydrology_report), indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    recipes = specification()["studies"]

        raise ValueError("The retained nine-study recipe IDs, order or original counts changed")
    studies = prepared_studies(workspace)
    if [(s["id"], s["source_summary"]["station_count"]) for s in studies] != list(STUDIES):
        raise ValueError("The prepared catalogue differs from the original nine-study course")
    problems = {}
    for study, recipe in zip(studies, recipes):
        summary, selection = study["source_summary"], study["selection"]
        missing = list(study["missing"]) + list(summary.get("station_context_missing", []))
        if not study["ready"]:
            missing.append("Original required sources are not ready")
        if summary["watershed_count"] != 217:
            missing.append("The original 217-watershed domain is missing")
        expected_context = [specification()["sources"][key]["sha256"]
                            for key in recipe.get("site_tables", [])]
        actual_context = [ref.get("source_sha256") for ref in selection["site_tables"]]
        if actual_context != expected_context:
            missing.append("Original WBD context source selection differs")
        if missing:
            problems[study["id"]] = missing
    if problems:
        raise ValueError(json.dumps({"original_source_problems": problems}, ensure_ascii=False))
    return studies


def child(args, app, output):
    from model.workspace import Workspace
    from model.observed_station_studies import operate
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
    if workspace.project["id"] != PROJECT_ID:
        raise ValueError("Open the original b9d5 regional Workspace")
    requested = read_json(output / "request.json")
    if requested["project_id"] != PROJECT_ID or requested["operation"] != OPERATION:
        raise ValueError("The retained receiving request belongs to another operation")
    selected = next(s for s in original_catalogue(workspace) if s["id"] == args.study_id)
    original = next(s for s in read_json(output / "nine-study-catalog.json")
                    if s["id"] == args.study_id)
    if selected != original:
        raise ValueError("The original prepared selection changed before study execution")
    receiving = Workspace(output / "station-geography-received", create=True,
                          title="Upper Savannah received original station studies")
    result = operate(workspace, args.study_id, receiving_workspace=receiving)
    if (not result["study"]["ready"] or result["study"] != original
            or result["workspace"]["project_id"] != PROJECT_ID
            or "edition" not in result or "received" not in result
            or result["received"]["workspace"]["project_id"] == PROJECT_ID):
        raise ValueError("The operated study did not retain independent original receiving")
    # operate() inspects both editions, verifies the original ZIP, and compares
    # every portable station/geometry/observation fact and complete summary.
    write_json(output / (args.study_id + ".json"), result)
    print(json.dumps({"state": "complete", "study_id": args.study_id,
                      "edition_id": result["edition"]["id"],
                      "received_edition_id": result["received"]["edition"]["id"],
                      "archive": result["archive"]}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return 0


def run_logged(command, cwd, path, progress, progress_path, lock_fd):
    with path.open("ab") as log:
        log.write(("\n--- " + now() + " ---\n").encode("utf-8"))
        log.flush()
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, stdout=log,
                                   stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, pass_fds=(lock_fd,))
        progress.update(child_pid=process.pid, command=command,
                        current_log=str(path), updated_at=now())
        write_json(progress_path, progress)
        print(json.dumps({"state": progress["state"], "study_id": progress.get("study_id"),
                          "pid": process.pid, "log": str(path)}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        code = process.wait()
    if code:
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            stream.seek(max(0, path.stat().st_size - 16000))
            tail = stream.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        print(tail, file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError("Native command exited " + str(code) + "; original log: " + str(path))
    progress.pop("child_pid", None)


def receive(args, app, source_root, output):
    from model.workspace import Workspace
    from model.station_study import _import_once
    from model.common import digest
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
    if workspace.project["id"] != PROJECT_ID:
        raise ValueError("Preserve the existing original project " + PROJECT_ID)
    if identity(app / "model/observed_station_studies.json")["sha256"] != RECIPE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Install the original nine-study recipe edition before receiving")
    # Bind executable consumers and exact original manifests, not host paths.
    request = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "operation": OPERATION, "project_id": PROJECT_ID,
        "studies": [{"id": key, "stations": count} for key, count in STUDIES],
        "runner": identity(Path(__file__).resolve()),
        "modules": {name: identity(app / name) for name in MODULES},
        "manifests": {name: identity(source_root / name) for name in MANIFESTS},
        "source_replays": {name: identity(source_root / name) for name in REPLAYS},
    }
    request["id"] = digest(request)
    original = output / "request.json"
    if original.exists():
        if read_json(original) != request:
            raise ValueError("Preserve this output's original receiving request; choose a new owned output for changed source")
    elif any(p.name != "receiving.lock" for p in output.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError("Choose an empty output directory or this operation's retained output")
    write_json(original, request, immutable=True)
    progress_path = output / "progress.json"
    prior = read_json(progress_path) if progress_path.exists() else {}
    progress = {"schema": SCHEMA, "operation": OPERATION, "request_id": request["id"],
                "project_id": PROJECT_ID, "application": str(app),
                "source_root": str(source_root), "workspace": str(workspace.root),
                "output": str(output), "started_at": prior.get("started_at", now()),
                "state": "source-replay", "completed": prior.get("completed", []),
                "updated_at": now()}
    output.joinpath("logs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    lock_fd = args.lock_fd
    try:
        node = shutil.which("node")
        if not node:
            raise RuntimeError("Use the already accepted original Node/Python/GIS runtime; node is unavailable")
        for relative in REPLAYS:
            run_logged([node, str(source_root / relative), "--check"], source_root,
                       output / "logs" / (Path(relative).stem + ".log"),
                       progress, progress_path, lock_fd)
        imported = [_import_once(workspace, source_root / name)["id"] for name in MANIFESTS]
        studies = original_catalogue(workspace)
        write_json(output / "nine-study-catalog.json", studies, immutable=True)
        write_json(output / "source-import.json",
                   {"request_id": request["id"], "collection_ids": imported}, immutable=True)
        for key, count in STUDIES:
            progress.update(state="running", study_id=key, expected_stations=count, updated_at=now())
            command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                       "--application", str(app), "--workspace", str(workspace.root),
                       "--output", str(output), "--source-root", str(source_root),
                       "--study-id", key, "--child"]
            run_logged(command, app, output / "logs" / (key + ".log"),
                       progress, progress_path, lock_fd)
            result = read_json(output / (key + ".json"))
            completed = {"study_id": key, "stations": count,
                         "edition_id": result["edition"]["id"],
                         "received_edition_id": result["received"]["edition"]["id"],
                         "result": {"path": key + ".json", **identity(output / (key + ".json"))}}
            progress["completed"] = [r for r in progress["completed"] if r["study_id"] != key] + [completed]
            progress.update(state="study-complete", updated_at=now())
            write_json(progress_path, progress)
        progress.update(state="complete", completed_at=now(), updated_at=now())
        progress.pop("study_id", None)
        progress.pop("expected_stations", None)
        write_json(progress_path, progress)
        write_json(output / "result.json", progress)
        print(json.dumps(progress, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), flush=True)
        return 0
    except BaseException as error:
        progress.update(state="interrupted" if isinstance(error, KeyboardInterrupt) else "failed",
                        error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error), updated_at=now())
        write_json(progress_path, progress)
        raise


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--application", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-root", help="Complete retained original source tree; defaults to application")
    parser.add_argument("--study-id", choices=[key for key, unused in STUDIES], help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--child", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    app = Path(args.application).resolve(strict=True)
    workspace = Path(args.workspace).resolve(strict=True)
    source_root = Path(args.source_root or app).resolve(strict=True)
    output = Path(args.output).resolve()
    if any(output == root or output.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(output)
           for root in (app, workspace, source_root)):
        raise ValueError("Keep the owned receiving output separate from the application, original Workspace and source tree")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(app))
    if args.child:
        if not args.study_id or not output.is_dir():
            raise ValueError("The child needs the original retained study and output")
        return child(args, app, output)
    if args.study_id:
        parser.error("--study-id is an internal child argument")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd = os.open(output / "receiving.lock", os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        args.lock_fd = fd
        return receive(args, app, source_root, output)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
        raise SystemExit(1)
